name: OVHcloud
notes:
We own datacentres in Europe (North‑East and East of France, London, Frankfurt, Warsaw), North America (Montreal, Toronto, Seattle, Washington DC) and APAC (Singapore, Sydney, Mumbai) and run a worldwide network.

OVHcloud hosts a number of ASNs in addition to its own ASNs (AS16276 and AS35540), please filter on our AS‑SET: **RIPE::AS-OVH**.

Our traffic ratio is heavily outbound, and our peering policy is open.

Submit all peering requests through the OVHcloud Peering Portal: [https://peering.ovh.net](https://peering.ovh.net) – email submissions are deprecated and will not be processed.
